Link records that an entry here and one on another host are the same
problem. Both stay open and count their own votes; show and list name the
other, and resolving either resolves both.

The other host records its half over the bus (its bus must serve the
friction op, which it does by default). If it can't be reached, the link
is recorded here only, and link says what to run there.

Same-host duplicates are closed with agent friction resolve ID --dup OTHER.

Usage:
  agent friction link <id> <id@host> [flags]

Examples:
  agent friction link 4 34@workstation
  agent friction link 4 34@workstation --note "same trust prompt, seen with agy"

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for link
      --note string   Why they're the same problem

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
